SELECT aa.*, am.model_name AS modelName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(at.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM AI_TOOL at WHERE FIND_IN_SET(at.id, aa.tool_ids)) AS toolNames, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(amc.server_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM AI_MCP_CONFIG amc WHERE FIND_IN_SET(amc.id, aa.mcp_ids)) AS mcpNames FROM AI_AGENT aa LEFT JOIN AI_MODEL_CONFIG am ON aa.model_id = am.id WHERE 1=1
AND aa.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.name}, '%')
AND aa.status = #{req.status}
ORDER BY aa.create_time DESC
